rows.task: predict the response to the next exercise from past interactions
rows.attention: self-attention over past interactions with the current exercise as query

rows.task: predict a response from past context and the current question
rows.attention: context-aware monotonic attention with distance decay

rows.task: P(current correctness | completed history, current skill, current action tokens)
rows.attention: two-layer causal Transformer encoder with a standard triangular mask
rows.embeddings: sum of frozen-vocabulary skill and action embeddings plus learned positions
